title: analysis: evaluate UI extension fields (source, groupBy, typeOptions) against existing ListViewSchema protocol
body:
Evaluated whether objectui console settings panel fields (`_source`, `_groupBy`, `_typeOptions`, `description`) need to be added to the spec protocol.

### Analysis Result — All fields are redundant with existing protocol

After careful evaluation, all four proposed fields already have equivalent coverage in the existing `ListViewSchema`:

| objectui Field | Existing Protocol Equivalent | Verdict |
|---|---|---|
| `description` | `description: I18nLabelSchema` (already on ListViewSchema) | ✅ Already exists |
| `_source` | `data: { provider: 'object', object: '...' }` (ViewDataSchema) | ❌ Redundant |
| `_groupBy` | `grouping: { fields: [{ field: '...' }] }` (GroupingConfigSchema) | ❌ Redundant |
| `_typeOptions` | `kanban` / `calendar` / `gantt` / `gallery` / `timeline` typed configs | ❌ Redundant — untyped `Record<string, unknown>` undermines Zod-first principle |

### Recommendation

The objectui console should align its internal fields to the existing spec protocol rather than the spec adding shorthand aliases that create ambiguity about which field is the source of truth. No schema changes are needed.
